title: ticfac status --follow ends on a prior incarnation's terminal line for a resumed local run
body: internal/cli/status.go renderStatusFrame (the local branch, around line 122) scans the whole standing feed for ANY run_finished or run_died line and marks the frame `ended`, with no cursor protection — the fix ticfac watch got in tick usx. A resumed local run's feed carries the failed incarnation's run_finished, so `ticfac status <run> --follow` stops following at the first frame and exits 0 while the run is alive and dispatching. Same defect family as tick bkg, different surface; not changed here because this tick's scope is statusmodel.runCompleted.
